name: Lakefront Biotherapeutics American Depositary Shares
summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV, formerly Galapagos NV, is a biotechnology company that focuses on transforming patient outcomes through scientific innovation. It is dedicated to building a pipeline of medicines for patients with serious diseases in therapeutic areas of unmet need, prioritizing oncology and immunology & inflammation programs. The company's clinical-stage portfolio is anchored by potential first-in-class treatments for autoimmune diseases.
